Statue of Liberty walking tour.summary: Ferry and grounds; keep tickets on phone and arrive early for security.
Statue of Liberty walking tour.itineraryNote: Ferry and grounds; keep tickets on phone and arrive early for security.
Statue of Liberty walking tour.description: Tripadvisor lists Statue City Cruises at 3.8/5 with about 1,955 reviews. Statue City Cruises general admission from Battery Park includes round-trip ferry, Liberty and Ellis islands, museums, and audio tours. Adults: $26.00 (fees included per statuecitycruises.com and NPS fee page). Allow airport-style screening at Castle Clinton and arrive early for timed ferry boarding.
Statue of Liberty walking tour.address: Castle Clinton, Battery Park, New York, NY 10004
Statue of Liberty walking tour.review1: At all times the company staff treated him preferentially both for boarding and disembarking from the ferry.
Statue of Liberty walking tour.review2: Took the ferry from Battery Park to Statue and Ellis. Very good timing and the crew to board and disembark were great at helping anyone that required help.
Statue of Liberty walking tour.review3: Pretty easy cruise out and back. No complaints.

Carbone.summary: Classic Italian; reserve the earliest table you can get.
Carbone.itineraryNote: Classic Italian; reserve the earliest table you can get.
Carbone.description: Google lists Carbone around 4.4/5 with thousands of reviews. Greenwich Village red-sauce dining room on Thompson Street; lunch Tue–Sun 11:30am–2pm and dinner nightly (carbonenewyork.com). Public lunch menu entrees list about $24–$54 on Yelp; Price: $48 per person dinner planning estimate before tax, tip, and drinks.
Carbone.review1: The spicy rigatoni vodka is still the dish everyone talks about after years of hype.
Carbone.review2: Reserve the earliest table you can get; the room fills fast on weekends.
Carbone.review3: Classic red-sauce room with polished service even when every seat is taken.

Jazz at Lincoln Center.summary: Evening set at Lincoln Center; book covers early for will-call pickup.
Jazz at Lincoln Center.itineraryNote: Evening set at Lincoln Center; book covers early for will-call pickup.
Jazz at Lincoln Center.description: Google shows Jazz at Lincoln Center/Dizzy's Club around 4.6/5. Dizzy's Club hosts nightly sets with Central Park views (jazz.org/dizzys). Ticket covers run about $20–$65+ depending on the act; Price: $35 per person cover planning estimate plus a $25 per person food-and-beverage minimum billed at the end of the set per jazz.org ticketing terms.
Jazz at Lincoln Center.address: Broadway at 60th Street, New York, NY 10019
Jazz at Lincoln Center.review1: Book covers early for will-call pickup; the room fills quickly on Friday sets.
Jazz at Lincoln Center.review2: Central Park views from the bandstand make the cover feel worth it even when the room is packed.
Jazz at Lincoln Center.review3: Staff handled our table timing smoothly even with the food-and-beverage minimum.

Afternoon matinee show.summary: Overlap window A: matinee tickets already held.
Afternoon matinee show.itineraryNote: Overlap window A: matinee tickets already held.
Afternoon matinee show.description: TKTS Times Square sells same-day and next-day matinee Broadway tickets at 20–50% off list, with the final price including an $8 per-ticket service charge (tdf.org/tkts). Example board pricing shows midweek matinees around $78 after discount; Price: $78 per person matinee ticket planning estimate before fees at the booth.
Afternoon matinee show.address: TKTS Times Square, Broadway at W 47th St, New York, NY 10036
Afternoon matinee show.review1: Same-day matinee discounts are real if you can tolerate the TKTS line.
Afternoon matinee show.review2: Board pricing made a midweek matinee affordable without committing weeks ahead.
Afternoon matinee show.review3: Service charge is spelled out before you pay, which helps when comparing seats.

Friend meetup at Bryant Park.summary: Overlap window B: friend meetup at the same hour.
Friend meetup at Bryant Park.itineraryNote: Overlap window B: friend meetup at the same hour.
Friend meetup at Bryant Park.description: Google lists Bryant Park around 4.7/5 with tens of thousands of ratings. Open-lawn meetup in Bryant Park during the Day 3 overlap window; no ticket is required for the park itself. Optional lunch at Bryant Park Grill nearby lists a chicken Caesar at $19.50 on the public menu; Price: $20 per person social lunch estimate if you eat before the meetup.
Friend meetup at Bryant Park.review1: Easy open-lawn meetup spot with plenty of seating when the weather cooperates.
Friend meetup at Bryant Park.review2: Bryant Park Grill nearby works if the group wants a quick lunch before the meetup.
Friend meetup at Bryant Park.review3: No ticket is required for the park itself, which keeps a social stop flexible.

Zabar's.description: Google lists Zabar's around 4.5/5. Iconic UWS specialty market and prepared-foods stop; useful for breakfast supplies, picnic items, coffee, smoked fish, and take-home food gifts. Expect crowds at peak times. Price: $18 per person picnic-supplies planning estimate.
Zabar's.summary: UWS specialty market; grab picnic supplies before a long day out.
Zabar's.review1: Best stop for smoked fish and picnic supplies before Central Park.
Zabar's.review2: Expect a crowd at peak hours, but the prepared foods counter saves time.
Zabar's.review3: Coffee and bakery cases make it an easy breakfast supply run.

Strand Book Store.description: Google lists Strand Book Store at 4.8/5 with more than 14,000 reviews. Classic NYC bookstore with new/used books, gifts, totes, stationery, and local character. Price: $22 per person book-and-gift planning estimate.
Strand Book Store.summary: Classic NYC bookstore; browse miles of shelves and rare finds.
Strand Book Store.review1: Best book shop ever. The thousands of other people in it at the same time we were must agree.
Strand Book Store.review2: A treasure trove for book lovers with neat gifts and book accoutrement.
Strand Book Store.review3: Staff found the title we wanted among thousands of books without a problem.

Motto by Hilton New York City Times Squa.address: 150 A West 48th Street, New York, NY 10036
Motto by Hilton New York City Times Squa.description: Booking.com lists Motto by Hilton New York City Times Square around 3.9/5 (~917 reviews). Neighborhood: Times Square; Price: $188/night; Excellent location, eco-certified; photos available; Status: candidate, not booked.
Motto by Hilton New York City Times Squa.summary: Times Square base with eco-certified rooms and strong transit access.
Motto by Hilton New York City Times Squa.review1: Great location, efficient and considerate staff and amenities.
Motto by Hilton New York City Times Squa.review2: Very clean and perfect location for a short Midtown stay.
Motto by Hilton New York City Times Squa.review3: Excellent Lincoln Center and Times Square access without a long walk.
